Role: Health Entrepreneur
Industry: Hospital & Health Care
Company size: Self-employed
Time used: 6-12 months
Overall rating: 5
Ease-of-use rating: 5
Pros: This was the first email marketing tool that I’ve used and I really enjoy it! It’s easy to see past campaigns, see and filter contacts based on what funnels they’re in and date that they’ve joined. There’s just a lot of useful stats available within this software to allow for good business decisions to be made. Their email templates just keep getting better too! Pretty user friendly.
Cons: No real complaints about this software. The templated emails can be a bit difficult and slow to use though. However, the basic emails are fast to access, write, and send off. I haven’t had any issues with scheduled emails or keeping myself organized with this software.

Industry: Restaurants
Company size: 201-500 employees
Time used: 2+ years
Overall rating: 5
Ease-of-use rating: 4
Pros: ActiveCampaign is SO easy to use and set up. Our monthly email have never looked better! I love that we can track open rates, unsubscribes, and link clicks quickly and efficiently. We have saved so much time (and money) but setting up our marketing with ActiveCampaign and letting the program do all of the heavy lifting.
Cons: We have three different brands under our company and it would be super awesome to share templates. Other than that, AC is awesome!

Cons: Es una herramienta amplia, por ende tiene una curva de aprendizaje y según el expertise del usuario puede llevar tiempo dominarla. Puede que se podría mejorar la parte de edición de los mails. Hay otros proveedores más fácil en ese aspecto.
Reasons for switching: Necesitaba mejorar la automatización y AC es ideal.
